title: BlockWallet
tagline: A revolutionary wallet to settle your payments on your desired chains
description: The Wallet that we have created can asks users to login via World ID using their World app proving that they are human, We also have a connect wallet option too. Once logged in users can directly store their chain ids and wallet addresses on chain using our contract. These can be changed only by the user.
